claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station with 8 to 10 games installed and one pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a closed grey laptop with a printed “TECHLINK GADGETS STORE” lid watermark; no PS4 console, games, or controller are shown.

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller is describing a PS4 bundle, but the witness photos show a laptop.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo/video of the exact item being sold: the PS4 console (front/back ports) plus the included games and controller, matching the listing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a laptop only (not a PS4 bundle), and treat as untested/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Brand/model not readable; cannot confirm exact laptop specs that drive value (CPU/RAM/storage).
risks.proof: One shot of the laptop bottom label (model/serial) and/or a boot screen showing system info (e.g., Windows “About” or BIOS/UEFI screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest-spec/most common used category for an unverified laptop.

risks.risk: Power/boot and screen health unknown (could be dead, has dead pixels, dim display).
risks.proof: Video clip: press power → logo → boot to desktop (or BIOS) plus a close-up of the screen showing brightness and no dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or screen-unknown (worst-case for buyers).

risks.proof: Photo/clip of the full keyboard and trackpad from above, showing all keys; ideally a typing test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard/inputs potentially faulty or incomplete.

risks.risk: Storage type/size and RAM unknown (SSD vs HDD, capacity).
risks.proof: Screenshot/clip from system info showing RAM size and storage type/capacity (Task Manager/CrystalDiskInfo).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the worst common configuration (smaller RAM and HDD/slow storage).

risks.risk: Battery health/charge capacity unknown (could be weak and die quickly).
risks.proof: Screenshot/clip of battery health/charge capacity (Windows battery report or BIOS battery info).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming poor battery life (adapter-only use).

risks.proof: Video clip showing at least: USB device detection, HDMI output (if port exists), and Wi‑Fi connection test.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming ports/connectivity may be unreliable.

risks.risk: Physical damage/repairs unknown beyond lid/hinge area (dents, cracks, hinge wear).
risks.proof: Full-body photos: both sides, bottom, corners, hinge area close-up, and any repair marks; plus hinge open/close video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with possible wear/hinge stress.

risks.risk: Charger/adapter included and condition unknown (could be missing or wrong wattage).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact charger/adapter label (wattage/voltage) and a clip showing it charging the laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming charger may be missing or not reliable.

proof_requests: Send clear photos/videos of the exact item you want to sell: laptop brand/model label and the full unit (front/back/sides/bottom).
If it is actually a PS4 slim bundle, send photos of the PS4 console plus the included games and the controller/pad—matching the same listing.
Provide a boot test video (power on → BIOS/boot → desktop) and a screen close-up for dead pixels/brightness.
Send system specs screenshot (RAM size, storage type/capacity) and battery health/charge capacity screenshot.
Show keyboard/trackpad condition (full keyboard photo + typing test clip).
Show ports working (USB detection + HDMI output test if available + Wi‑Fi connection).
Show charger/adapter label and charging test.
response.reason: The witness photos show a laptop, while the seller claims a PS4 slim bundle; this mismatch prevents confident pricing without proof of the exact item and its working condition.
